builtInQueries.name: Large Cap Value Recovery Screener
builtInQueries.description: Large-cap recovery candidates with quality, ownership and valuation filters

builtInQueries.description: Technical scan of tracked stocks using Wilder RSI(14); requires authorized NSE historical bars
builtInQueries.focus: Wilder RSI(14) ≤ 30; tracked symbols only, unavailable until authorized NSE history is configured
builtInQueries.query: Technical scan: RSI(14) <= 30; tracked universe only

builtInQueries.name: 5% Crash Scanner — authorized daily bars required

builtInQueries.query: Technical scan: daily change <= -5%; tracked universe only

limitations: This inventory captures the seven built-in definitions found in the inspected PR #55 branch.
Per-device localStorage overrides and scan history cannot be read from the GitHub repository; they must be exported from each installed device before a storage migration.
This inventory does not prove that every Screener query is currently accessible or executable with the user's authenticated account.
